definitions.gloss: to examine (medically); to see a patient
definitions.explanation: To examine a patient as a medical professional, to provide medical care or consultation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{診|み}てもらう。
examples.english: To be examined by a doctor.

notes:
{診|み}る means to examine medically, different from {見|み}る (to see/look).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Conjugation: Ichidan ({一段|いちだん})
- Pattern: Xを{診|み}る (to examine X)

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {診|み}る: to examine (medically)
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see, to look at
- {看|み}る: to look after, to take care of

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医者|いしゃ}に{診|み}てもらう (to be seen by a doctor)
- {患者|かんじゃ}を{診|み}る (to examine a patient)
- {病気|びょうき}を{診|み}る (to diagnose an illness)

RELATED TERMS:
- {診察|しんさつ}: medical examination
- {診断|しんだん}: diagnosis
- {診療|しんりょう}: medical treatment
